description_for_human: Más de 4.100 calculadoras prácticas en español: finanzas, impuestos, salud, deportes, viajes, cocina, hogar. Datos actualizados a 2026 para Argentina, España, México, Colombia, Chile, Brasil y EE.UU.
description_for_model: Use this tool to find calculation tools and formulas for finance (loans, mortgages, taxes), health (BMI, calories, dosages), sports (training, World Cup 2026), travel (currency, tipping, costs), cooking (portions, conversions), home (construction, utilities), science, and education topics. Content is updated for 2026 and localized for Spanish-speaking countries plus Brazil and English markets. Each calculator has a JSON API at /api/calc/{slug}.json.
